service.description: A message from the signed-in user for sendDate (a minute to a year ahead; at most 100 waiting), with the rules of send#Message now: a member of a room that is not archived, a body or files (the user's uploads of the room not yet sent), a reply or a thread of the room, the record cards (recordList). In an encrypted room no body, files or records: heldByDeviceId, a device of the user's, keeps the draft and sends it (reasonCode encryptedRoom, noDevice). Refused: notMember, archived, badTime, tooMany, empty, tooLong, notFound. Out: chatScheduledMessageId, scheduled (as get#ChatSchedule lists it).

A waiting message's new body (with its record cards, recordList, looked up again from it) or sendDate (its files stay). A held one (an encrypted room's): its time only, from its device (deviceId). Refused: notScheduled (sent, or no longer waiting), notHolder, badTime.
Cancel a waiting or failed message, from any device of the sender; its files are removed. Refused while a device sends it (sending).
The sender has seen that a held message went late: it leaves the list.
Send a waiting or failed message the server holds at once, by the path of its time. A held one is sent by its device (notHolder). Out: eventSeq.

Internal, in a transaction of its own (send#DueMessages, send#ScheduledMessageNow): the send of one message the server holds that is due (or atOnce), its row locked, as its sender at this time (run#AsSender): not when their account is closed or terminated (accountDisabled), they lost the app's screens (noAccess), they are no longer a member (notMember), the room is archived (archived) or they blocked its number or person since (blocked); else send#Message with clientRef sched:(id), which a retry answers with the message it made, and CsmSent with its text cleared. A sign-in lock of the account is waiting: nothing is done or counted. A refusal is an error with reasonCode: the send rolls back and the caller fails the row (fail#ScheduledMessage). skipped: not waiting or not due.

Internal, in a transaction of its own: a send that did not go. With a reasonCode it is CsmFailed and the sender gets ChatScheduleFailed and their lists are told; without one it is tried again at the next run, 5 tries in all. Out: failed.

The ServiceJob send_DueChatMessages_frequent, every minute: the waiting messages the server holds that are due (the held ones never in their way), oldest first, at most limit a run, chat@schedule-user-per-run (20) of one sender, and none started after timeBudgetSeconds, each in a transaction of its own (deliver#ScheduledMessage): one that fails is logged and the rest go on. A held message (an encrypted room's) is its device's to send: one whose device was revoked fails (deviceGone), and one due more than chat@held-overdue-days (7) ago fails (deviceAway: its device was not open since).

An encrypted room's held message, taken by its device (deviceId, the one that holds it) to send: when due, or with atOnce (Send now, Review and send), still waiting, not waiting for the sender's review (unless atOnce) and with no live lease, a lease of 2 minutes; claimed true, and its clientRef. sent true when the room already has its message, whatever the row's status (a report that was lost, before a revoke or a cancel: it is marked sent). A failed one is not taken again. A sender who is no longer a member, an archived room or a blocked conversation fails it (reasonCode). Refused: notHolder.

The holding device's encrypted send of a held message it claimed (encrypted, the Megolm ciphertext, and mentionUserIdList), the row locked: refused (notClaimed) unless it still waits, claimed by deviceId with its lease live, so a message cancelled meanwhile does not go; then send#Message with clientRef sched:(id) and CsmSent in the same transaction. Out: eventSeq, event, sentLate.

The holding device could not send a held message: review true when it waits for the sender's decision (a verified person's new device or identity: listed with Review and send, not sent by itself meanwhile, not counted); else one try more (reasonCode, failText), and after 5 it fails and the sender is told.

The holding device's report: eventSeq, the sender's message of the room with clientRef sched:(id), makes it CsmSent whatever its status (sentLate when more than 5 minutes after its time; sentAfterCancel when it was cancelled meanwhile); draftLost true fails it (draftLost: the device no longer has the draft). Refused for another event, another device.

The signed-in user's scheduledList (waiting and failed, and held ones sent late and not dismissed in the last week; each with its room, time, status, body, files, reply, thread, held, heldByDeviceId and heldByDeviceName, deviceGone, sentLate, reasonCode) and reminderList (pending, soonest first, in the rooms they can read now: room, message, time, sender, and a plain room's snippet read now; an encrypted room's has none, only its ciphertext, encryptedContent, for the browser).

A reminder for the signed-in user at remindDate (a minute to a year ahead; at most 200 pending) of a message (not removed) of a room they can read now. It replaces their pending one of that message. It keeps no text. Refused: notFound, badTime, tooMany.

Internal, in a transaction of its own (send#DueReminders): a reminder that is due, as its user at this time (run#AsSender): waiting on a sign-in lock of the account; dropped (CrmDropped) when the message is gone (messageGone), the account is closed (accountDisabled), or the app's screens or the room can no longer be read (noAccess); else a CuaReminder Activity row, its push (queue#ReminderPush) and the ChatReminder notification, each logged when it fails, and CrmFired. Out: fired, dropped.
The ServiceJob send_DueChatReminders_frequent, every minute: each reminder due, oldest first, in a transaction of its own (fire#Reminder): one that fails is logged and the rest go on.

Internal (fire#Reminder): a reminder's push to each device of userId (a PushOutbox row of kind PokReminder), in the caller's transaction, the push worker woken after the commit: held during do not disturb, not dropped by a read marker, with a collapse key and tag of its own; a notification push of title, and the message's snippet as its body only in a plain room for a user whose previews are on (else hiddenBody).

Internal (the jobs): serviceName, ChatServices send#Message or get#RoomAccess, run as userId at this time: accountState ok, closed (closed for good, or terminated) or locked (a sign-in lock in its window: try again later); the screens of screenList (root first, those the row was made through) pushed as the user, else reasonCode noAccess; then the service with authorization off, its out-parameters as result and its errors as errors. A required or expired password change does not stop it: the user is set with none of a sign-in's checks.
The ServiceJob clean_ChatSchedule_daily: sent, cancelled and failed messages (a failed one with its text and files) and fired, cancelled and dropped reminders after 7 days; each on its own.
